The canonical scene whose composed restart wiring the fixture's hand-built equivalent stands in for; not itself opened by this PlayMode fixture, which builds its own test-owned owners

gate_results.notes: Authoritative PlayMode run at validated commit 5625988dc70bb677b34eb69dbe03499153fcee20 through run_unity_tests_clean.ps1, filter NoSafeCircle.DoorPrototype.Tests.FloorRunRestartPlayModeTests: 4 tests, 4 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped, runner exit 0, final line VALIDATION PASSED. Counts read from test-results.xml (total="4" passed="4" failed="0" skipped="0"), not the console summary. The bound manifest records commit and post_commit both 5625988dc70bb677b34eb69dbe03499153fcee20 and tree and post_tree both a6e149636e231b3c6aad95547679f38f3a94b585, clean before and after. All four cases declare NoSafeCircle.DoorPrototype.Tests.FloorRunRestartPlayModeTests (a non-partial class). PlayerDied_TriggersFreshRestart_ExactlyOncePerZeroHealthTransition (its own file comment marks it VAL-001) reduces Player Health to zero twice, independently, and asserts a Died-count increment of exactly one on each transition, proving a fresh restart fires exactly once per zero-health transition rather than firing on every frame at zero or failing to re-arm after the first. NonFatalDamage_DoesNotTriggerRestart is the accompanying regression: 25% damage that keeps health above zero leaves mana and position untouched, ruling out a threshold- or polling-based trigger.

PlayerDied_RestartsAllCurrentlyExistingOwners_ToFloorInitialState (marked VAL-002 in its own file comment) damages Player Health and Player Mana by half, moves the player 3m off its floor-initial position, opens two separate doors, and click-selects a third sealed door through PlayerInteractionController before reducing health to zero. After the zero-health transition it asserts Player Health and Player Mana are back at their max (floor-initial) values, player position (x and z) matches the recorded floor-initial position with HasActiveDestination false, both doors report IsOpen false with Progress 0 and their visual/collider restored, and PlayerInteractionController's PendingDoor is null with IsInteracting and HasLockedDoorInteraction both false. This covers Player Health, Player Mana, player position, and door-open-interaction state (progress/open/blocker) exactly as VAL-002 requires, and additionally proves every currently active door is reset (not only a single serialized reference) and that the locked-door-interaction suppression is cleared. Counts read from the same test-results.xml as VAL-001 (total=4 passed=4 failed=0 skipped=0).
